notes.title: Sign up for Our Kickstarter Pre-Launch!
notes.content:
🎮 Exciting News! 🎮

Hey everyone,

I'm thrilled to announce that the Kickstarter pre-launch page is live!

We've been hard at work developing this game, and now we need your support to bring it to life. With your help, we can make this game the best it can be.

Head over to our Kickstarter page to sign up and learn more about the game. There will be awesome rewards for you to pledge your support. Every contribution counts, no matter how big or small!

Let's make this game a reality together! 🚀

Check out our Kickstarter pre-launch page here: [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/2050140095/the-wedding-1?ref=clipboard-prelaunch]Kickstarter.[/url]
